ENVO AT23 Electric Side-by-Side UTV and SxS | Compact 4x4 e-UTV
The ENVO AT23 is a compact electric side-by-side UTV and SxS designed for work, recreation, patrol, property access, and mixed-terrain transportation. It combines comfortable side-by-side seating with the stability of a four-wheel platform and the quiet, responsive performance of an electric drivetrain. Smaller and lighter than many conventional utility terrain vehicles and side-by-sides, the AT23 is easier to maneuver, park, store, and transport while remaining highly useful for farms, ranches, estates, parks, resorts, campgrounds, beaches, job sites, security routes, tourism operations, and private properties. Its low-noise electric operation also makes this electric SxS suitable for guest-facing, livestock, wildlife, and nature-sensitive environments.
Accessories shown may be optional, not included in the base price, or unavailable for individual sale. Check the product configuration or contact us for details.
